messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Tamil, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Tamil line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Source → Tamil)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (Tamil → English) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|--------------------------------------|--------| | Vedi | imperative “see / behold” | **பாருங்கள்** | “(you) see / behold” | OK | | la | definite article (feminine) | **(அந்த)** | “the / that” (demonstrative) | UNNECESSARY | | bestia | “beast” (object) | **மிருகத்தைப்** | “the beast (ACC.)” | OK | | per | preposition “because of / for” | **காரணமாக** | “as a cause / because of” | OK | | cu' | relative pronoun “which / that” | **அது** | “that / it” | OK | | io | 1st‑person pronoun “I” | **நான்** | “I” | OK | | mi | reflexive pronoun “myself” | **(omitted)** | – | UNNECESSARY | | volsi | “turned” (self‑directed) | **திரும்பினேன்** | “I turned” | OK | | aiutami | “help me” (imperative) | **எனக்கு உதவுங்கள்** | “help me” | OK | | da | preposition “against” | **எதிராக** | “against” | OK | | lei | 3rd‑person feminine pronoun “her” | **அவளுக்கு** | “to her / her” (as object of “against”) | OK | | famoso | adjective “famous” | **புகழ்பெற்ற** | “famous” | OK | | saggio | noun “sage” (vocative) | **ஞானி** | “sage” | OK | | ch'ella | conjunction + pronoun “that she / for she” | **அவள்** | “she” | OK | | mi (in clause) | 1st‑person pronoun “my” (possessor) | **என்** | “my” | OK | | fa | verb “makes / causes” | **செய்கிறாள்** | “does / makes” (3rd‑sg) | OK | | tremar | infinitive “to tremble” | **நடுங்கச்** | “to cause to tremble” (causative stem) | OK | | le | definite article (feminine plural) | **(omitted)** | – | UNNECESSARY | | vene | “veins” (plural) | **நரம்புகள்** | “veins” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | **மற்றும்** | “and” | OK | | i | definite article (masc. plural) | **(omitted)** | – | UNNECESSARY | | polsi | “pulses” (plural) | **துடிப்புகளை** | “pulses (ACC.)” | OK |
### Items flagged
- **UNNECESSARY**: `la`, `mi` (reflexive), `le`, `i` – Tamil does not use articles or a separate reflexive pronoun in these contexts. - **No MISSING or WRONG entries** – every source token has a corresponding Tamil rendering (or a justified omission). - **No GRAMMAR errors** – the Tamil translation respects agreement and case conventions.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Tamil script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 88: - Original: **Vedi la bestia per cu' io mi volsi;** - Issue: none - Corrected: **அந்த மிருகத்தைப் பாருங்கள் அது காரணமாக நான் திரும்பினேன்;**
- Line 89: - Original: **aiutami da lei, famoso saggio,** - Issue: internal punctuation (comma) moved to line‑end only - Corrected: **எனக்கு அவளுக்கு எதிராக உதவுங்கள் புகழ்பெற்ற ஞானி,**
- Line 90: - Original: **ch'ella mi fa tremar le vene e i polsi».** - Issue: none - Corrected: **அவள் என் நரம்புகள் மற்றும் துடிப்புகளை நடுங்கச் செய்கிறாள்»**
``` அந்த மிருகத்தைப் பாருங்கள் அது காரணமாக நான் திரும்பினேன்; எனக்கு அவளுக்கு எதிராக உதவுங்கள் புகழ்பெற்ற ஞானி, அவள் என் நரம்புகள் மற்றும் துடிப்புகளை நடுங்கச் செய்கிறாள்» ```
